rules.statement: A child born in adultery, prior to the Kandyan Law Declaration and Amendment Ordinance coming into operation, is entitled to a child's share of the acquired property of his father even if the father leaves some legitimate children.
rules.supporting_quote: "Dingiri Banda, though born in adultery, would, therefore, be entitled to a child's share of the acquired property of Kirihamy even if Kirihamy left some legitimate children (vide Hayley, Sinhalese Laws and Customs, page 390, and Punchirala v. Perera [(1919) 21 New Law Report 145.])."
